name: zutil_zrdr_push_free_node
description: zUtil_ZRDR::PushFreeNode lazily creates the ZRDR free-pool list, inserts a free node as the new head, maintains circular links, and increments free counters.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target covers this isolated function yet.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x48c820 validates lazy zArchiveList::CreateEmpty allocation when g_zUtil_ZRDR_FreePool is null, first-node self-linking, non-empty insertion through zArchiveList::LinkNodeBetween(head->prev, node, head), storing the pushed node as the new head, incrementing the list count, and incrementing g_zUtil_ZRDR_FreeCount.
The dependency frontier reports no source blockers; zArchiveList::CreateEmpty and zArchiveList::LinkNodeBetween are already functional-ready.

Native smoke zreader_zrdr_push_free_node_smoke verifies the lazy-create/first-node path, the second-node head insertion/linking path, free-pool count, free-count increment, and no grow-count side effect.
